FlexScriptClass.name: Particles.Vec3
FlexScriptClass.Summary: A node-backed 3-component vector used for an emitter's gravity and wind (both accelerations, length / time^2). Components can be read and written individually and persist in the tree.

Description.p: Because it is node-backed, component assignment writes through:
Description.code: Particles.Emitter e = Model.find("ParticleEmitter1"); e.gravity.z = -9.8; // component write, persists e.wind = Vec3(1, 0, 0); // whole-vector assign from a FlexSim Vec3 print(e.gravity); // [x, y, z]
